# Smart India Hackathon 2026 - Sharda University

This is the official website for Smart India Hackathon 2026 at Sharda University, India's largest hackathon fostering innovation and technology solutions.

## Website Information

- **URL**: https://sih.awscc.dev
- **Organization**: Sharda University
- **Event**: Smart India Hackathon 2026
- **Location**: Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://sih.awscc.dev/) - Main landing page with event overview
- [About](https://sih.awscc.dev/about) - Information about SIH and Sharda University
- [Timeline](https://sih.awscc.dev/timeline) - SIH 2026 schedule and important dates
- [Announcements](https://sih.awscc.dev/announcements) - Latest news and updates
- [Guidelines](https://sih.awscc.dev/guidelines) - Participation rules and guidelines
- [FAQ](https://sih.awscc.dev/faq) - Frequently asked questions
- [Contact](https://sih.awscc.dev/contact) - Contact information for coordinators

## Important Resources

- [Official SIH Website](https://www.sih.gov.in) - Government SIH portal
- [Problem Statements](https://www.sih.gov.in/sih2026PS) - Official problem statement repository
- [Sharda University](https://www.sharda.ac.in) - University website

## Event Details

Smart India Hackathon 2026 is a 36-hour continuous hackathon where students from across India compete to solve real-world problems. The event is organized by the Government of India in collaboration with Sharda University.

### Key Dates

- SPOC Registration: 14 August 2026
- Problem Statement Launch: To be announced
- Team Registration: To be announced
- Internal Hackathon: To be announced
- Grand Finale: December 2026

### Themes

The hackathon covers 18 major themes including:
- Smart Automation
- Heritage & Culture
- Agriculture/FoodTech
- Smart Vehicles
- Transportation
- Robotics & Drones
- Clean & Green Tech
- Tourism
- Renewable Energy
- Blockchain & Security
- Smart Education
- Disaster Management
- Games & Toys
- Fintech
- Space Technology
- Fitness & Sports
- MedTech/HealthTech
- Miscellaneous

## Accessibility

This website is designed to be accessible to all users, following WCAG guidelines. It includes proper color contrast, semantic HTML, and keyboard navigation support.

## SEO

The website is optimized for search engines with:
- Proper meta tags and Open Graph data
- Structured data (Event, Organization, WebSite schemas)
- Sitemap.xml for search engine crawling
- Robots.txt for crawler instructions
